description: This Java class `PlaceholderFilter` provides methods for processing templates with placeholders, supporting placeholder resolution, validation, and transformation mainly within the context of authorization and configuration. It handles placeholder replacement in strings, applies functions pipelines to placeholders, and ensures correct placeholder syntax and resolution.

classes.name: PlaceholderFilter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for placeholder resolution, validation, and application in templates, specifically for handling authorization contexts and string templates.

methods.name: applyHeadersPlaceholderToAuthContext
methods.description: Replaces headers placeholders in an AuthorizationContext based on provided headers and returns a new AuthorizationContext with placeholders applied.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Resolves placeholders within a template string using a source object and placeholder definition, returning the processed string.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Resolves placeholders within a template string using an ExpressionResolver.

methods.name: applyOrElseDelete
methods.description: Attempts to resolve placeholders; if unsuccessful or results in deletion, returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: applyOrElseRetain
methods.description: Attempts to resolve placeholders; if unsuccessful, returns the original template string.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all placeholders in the template can be resolved with provided placeholders.

methods.name: validateAndReplace
methods.description: Validates placeholders and replaces them with a dummy string, returning the fully resolved template.
